prompt: Draft a quick message to my team about the standup being moved to 3pm tomorrow

assertions.name: casual-salutation
assertions.description: Opens with a casual salutation (Ciao, Hi, Hey team — not Gentile or Dear)

assertions.name: mentions-3pm
assertions.description: The new time (3pm or 15:00) is clearly stated

assertions.name: body-is-brief
assertions.description: Body is short — under 5 sentences, no unnecessary elaboration

assertions.name: no-padding-phrases
assertions.description: Does not contain filler like 'I hope this finds you well' or 'please don't hesitate to'

assertions.name: casual-sign-off
assertions.description: Closes informally (Saluti, Thanks, Cheers — not Distinti saluti)
